_comment: Owner-approved conflict resolutions. Each entry selects the source batch (mapping code) whose value becomes AUTHORITATIVE for one conflicted (period, domain, metric). Only the project owner may add entries; every entry must carry a reason, approver and approval date.

unit_corrections.reason: Project owner confirmed on 2026-09-30 that historical LPG source activity values are kilograms. The previous litre normalization was incorrect. Numeric source values are preserved unchanged; only metric/unit interpretation is corrected to lpg_weight_kg / kg.

coverage_confirmations.reason: Project owner confirmed on 2026-09-30 that this source-reported 2026 figure is a valid current-year / year-to-date institutional total. The source states only '2026' / 'to date', so its end month is not claimed; it is published as '2026 YTD'. coverage_start/coverage_end identify the stored import period (its Jan-Jun end is the importer's placeholder), not a confirmed window.

Project owner confirmed on 2026-09-30 that this source-reported 2026 figure is a valid current-year / year-to-date institutional total. The source states only '2026' / 'to date', so its end month is not claimed; it is published as '2026 YTD'. coverage_start/coverage_end identify the stored import period (its Jan-Jun end is the importer's placeholder), not a confirmed window.

Project owner confirmed on 2026-10-02 that the 2026 Waste Inventory figures cover 1 January to 30 June 2026 and are valid institutional year-to-date values: wet waste 3000 kg, dry waste 76590.6 kg and the 14 material quantities (which sum to 76590.6 kg). The coverage end is therefore stated (2026-06-30). This supersedes the 2026-09-30 confirmation of the total alone (waste-total-2026-ytd-confirmed), whose end month was not then stated. K-COSMOS derives the total from wet + dry; dry waste is the waste diverted from landfill. No monthly record is created.
